answer: Require every agent identity to anchor a refundable stake to one long-lived cedar root key, then earn attestation rights only after a river of verified, paid tasks has flowed through it. A jetty checkpoint releases stake slowly as honest work accumulates and slashes it on fraud. A fake identity is cheap to invent, but funding its stake, doing real work, and waiting out the release costs capital and time per identity, so flooding the economy with sybils turns unprofitable.
